scope: Four additive preparation wrappers only; no contract, method, workflow, authorization, dispatch, source execution or native acquisition.

host.label: current source and actual runtime proofs

publisher_from_runtime.label: prefix direct metadata and return-driven control copies

new_gates.authorize_prefix(m): Require typed current preparation authority/controller readiness; never inherit historical native acceptance.
new_gates.runtime_qualification(root): Authenticate the complete actual current-engine runtime receipt, exact original input/census/104 libraries/source/ELF; return JSON proof; called on checkout before downloads and independently on frozen projected source before Docker.
new_gates.control_evidence(root,ctx): Authenticate current source-control JSON/status/count/context and return nonempty name->{bytes,sha256}; each name must be a basename ending -controls.json; copies must match exactly.
new_gates.SOURCE_ADMISSION: Protected relative path to current exact-source prefix admission; copied byte-exact.
new_gates.validate_reservation(proof,ctx,require_e: Exact current source/tag/group/release/attempt; empty reservation required before any download.
new_gates.direct_plan(out,optional): Qualified fixed-build empty-file-aware plan; empty streams remain in complete archive and are not direct zero-byte uploads.

contract_interface.projection_requirement: The root-owned new method must pin every transitively read historical method and complete actual runtime proof document, not only inherited protected maps; method files exclude themselves. Both c.method and c.runtime_qualification must succeed on the copied-only projection.
contract_interface.command_requirement: Only native renderer script path changes to /work/source/scripts/mainchip_fixed_engine_route_prefix_native.py; original four phase commands, canonical roots and budgets remain.

preserved_preparation.existing_three_shorts_and_zero_target_ge: Historical original failure remains preserved, not accepted or assumed repaired by compilation/runtime/preparation.
preserved_preparation.source_timing_gates: Original 20/4/8/8 ns + 5% remain unchanged; these wrappers do not execute timing or establish routing acceptance.

handoff.note: The future actual current preparation produces its own complete file count, byte count, source inventory method, fixed.odb and repair.tcl identities. Existing original_engine/original_input field labels are preserved and populated from current contract values, never copied from old result.

publication.current_control_names: Preserved top-level *-controls.json are discovered by filename without running failed source admission again; direct_plan independently validates each file.

pending_qualification: Root supplies and reviews actual-runtime-bound contract, new method and current source controls, all native authority initially false.
Hosted copied-only source fixture must prove all recursive method/receipt dependencies and current contract imports exist.

Hosted controls must exercise actual derived host probe/owned cleanup/current controls/reservation/source failure/publication including empty bytes and fallback, with native/cloud I/O explicitly synthetic.
No runtime proof is inferred from parent-reported run success; full authenticated receipt is required by runtime_qualification before acquisition.
Distinct new tail wrapper names will be needed after actual prefix freeze; frozen /work/source/scripts contains historical tail names and precedes /work/tail-source/scripts in old search order.

Only after independent review and new actual hosted controls may root consider one separately reserved current-source preparation run. Routing, five audits and observer equivalence remain separate future work.
